label: D2 after choosing a2 while the a2 preference is weak (recent switch to a2 / uncertain policy)
explanation: Fires only at DELAY_2 and only when this trial's GO choice was a2 (in_action == 2; recall 1.0 for phase==D2 & action==2, but precision 0.17). Among those steps, it is active when the model's policy logit (a1 - a2) at D2 is not strongly negative, i.e. the agent holds only a weak preference for a2: choice > -3 gives dev P 0.60 / R 0.77 / F1 0.68 / mass recall 0.89. Magnitude is largest right after switching to a2 (stay == 0: precision 0.82, covers 57% of the top quartile vs 7% of the lowest), after an unrewarded previous trial, and when a2 led to its common state S2 (91% of mass). Never fires at D1 or GO, never after choosing a1. Uses only observed variables (this trial's choice is known at D2) plus the model's own policy output. Weak residual activations occur on repeated a2 choices with weak preference; it is silent on long a2 streaks with a confident a2 policy.
